name: stag-plugin-task-log
description: stag.ai plugin: at the end of the day, writes the tasks agents finished into the workspace vault.

stagPlugin.description: At the end of each workday, writes the tasks agents finished (and those still open) into each workspace's vault, one note per day, for you and your agents to look back on. The plugin rewrites the note on every run.
stagPlugin.author: stag.ai

folder.title: Vault folder
folder.description: Notes are written to <folder>/YYYY-MM-DD.md in the workspace vault.

jobs.description: 18:00 Monday–Friday: logs today's finished tasks for every workspace that has any.
